verse.verse_1: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
verse.verse_2: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
verse.verse_3: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
verse.verse_5: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
verse.verse_6: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
